clauses: What may be traded and when

operative_quotes:
Players may trade **at any time, even off-turn**, except during boss-tie resolution or after End of Game is drawn. Multiple players may participate. Trade any combination of **money, lots, dice in casinos and actions performed on the acting player’s current turn**.

For a transferred lot replace the owner’s marker with the recipient’s marker. For a transferred casino die replace it with the recipient’s die, retaining the **current pip value**, not the board’s printed die. A die trade can therefore change the boss and cause an immediate highest tie.

You **cannot trade points or casino tiles**, or promise actions, exchanges or transfers for **future turns**. **No player can perform an action on another player’s turn.** A current-turn action can be part of a trade only for the player whose turn it is. observed_raw_entry.answer: Players may trade money, lots, casino dice, and actions performed on the active player’s current turn, at any time except during boss-tie resolution or after End of Game. A lot transfers by replacing its marker; a die transfers by replacing it with the recipient’s die at the same current pip value, potentially triggering a boss tie. Points and casino tiles cannot be traded; future-turn actions, exchanges, or transfers cannot be promised. Only the active player may perform an action, including one included in a trade.
